text:
Ava: Quick security advisory — starting next week we are enforcing session boundary policies for interactive dev shells (GKE dev-shell, bastion SSH, and internal workspace shells). Any interactive session idle > 2h or active > 8h will be forcibly re-authenticated. Enforcement date: Tue Mar 31 08:00 UTC. Please read below and take action if you rely on long-lived shells.

security-bot: Docs + rollout plan: https://internal.redwood/sec/session-boundaries (ACLs, exception flow, rollback). Policy ID: SEC-IB-2026-07.

Maya: What exactly do teams need to change? Will CI be affected?

Ava: CI pipelines are unaffected — this is for interactive sessions only. Action items for engineers: 1) Stop running long lived daemons in an interactive shell; move them to a job/cron or k8s Job. 2) Replace personal long-lived tokens with ephemeral credentials (gcloud auth login / oidc) where possible. 3) If you need an exception file the form linked in the docs by EOD Mon Mar 30.

Jordan: For services that legitimately need persistent access (eg hardware dev rigs), what's the exception SLA?

Ava: Exceptions limited to infra teams and require a short justification + scheduled re-review every 30 days. Expect a 48h turnaround. Use the exception template in the doc.

DevX: We'll push an update to the internal dev-shell wrapper tomorrow that will transparently refresh creds and surface a reauth notification. TL;DR: most folks will just re-login once every 8h.

Eli: Any commands we should run now to preempt surprises?

DevX: Run this to check active sessions and timestamp: ```
# list active dev-shell sessions
./dev-shellctl list --format=json | jq '.sessions[] | {user, started, idle}'
# expire your own long sessions
./dev-shellctl expire --user $USER --older-than 8h
```

Maya: If my terminal background job gets killed, is there a safe pattern to preserve progress?

Ava: Use `tmux`+`reconnect` is not allowed as a long-term workaround. Preferred: containerize the work in a k8s Job or use `screen --detach` only for <2h interactive debugging then ship logs to S3. Add a short README to repos showing how to run locally as a job.

Jordan: Is there telemetry we can opt into to see how many sessions we'll expire?

security-bot: We've published a dashboard: https://internal.redwood/mon/dashboards/session-expiry. Current estimate: ~420 active interactive sessions >8h across infra and eng. We'll post hourly counts during rollout.

Eli: If the enforcement triggers workflow breakage, who do we ping?

Ava: Ping #eng-oncall and tag @Ava and @DevX. We'll have a triage channel and a 2h rollback window on day-of.

Maya: Noted — we'll add a note to onboarding docs for new hires.

Jordan: Can we get the exception form link?

Ava: Form: https://internal.redwood/requests/sec-exception?policy=SEC-IB-2026-07. Please include owner, justification, duration, and a re-review date.

DevX: Rolling update plan: feature-flag ON in staging Fri Mar 27, canary Mon Mar 30 (10% sessions), full enforcement Tue Mar 31 08:00 UTC. We'll post an incident-style thread if we need to pause.

security-bot: Enforcement flag toggled to `canary` at 2026-03-30T09:00:00Z (logged).

Eli: Thanks — good to know timeline. We'll hunt for any lingering long-running shells and notify our teams. :thumbsup:

Maya: Acknowledged — dev docs update in progress.

Ava: Thanks everyone. If you have any blockers file a ticket with priority P1 and include logs. (reaction :eyes:)
